description: This file contains internal definitions, structures, macros, and function prototypes for elliptic curve cryptography (EC) operations within the OpenSSL library, specifically related to the internal EC implementation and Montgomery multiplication methods.

classes.name: EC_GROUP
classes.description: Represents an elliptic curve group with associated parameters and methods.

classes.name: EC_POINT
classes.description: Represents a point on an elliptic curve within a group.

classes.name: EC_METHOD
classes.description: Structure containing function pointers for EC operations, allowing different implementations.

classes.name: EC_WRAPPED_SCALAR
classes.description: A structure holding both an EC_SCALAR and a BIGNUM representation for private keys.

classes.name: built_in_curve
classes.description: Structure describing a standard elliptic curve, including its OID and parameters.

classes.name: built_in_curves
classes.description: Container for a set of predefined elliptic curves.

methods.name: ec_bignum_to_scalar
methods.description: Converts a BIGNUM to an EC_SCALAR, ensuring it is within the group order.

methods.name: ec_scalar_to_bytes
methods.description: Serializes an EC_SCALAR to a big-endian byte array.

methods.name: ec_scalar_from_bytes
methods.description: Deserializes bytes into an EC_SCALAR, validating the input.

methods.name: ec_scalar_reduce
methods.description: Reduces a large number modulo the group order to an EC_SCALAR.

methods.name: ec_random_nonzero_scalar
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random scalar in the range [1, order-1].

methods.name: ec_scalar_equal_vartime
methods.description: Checks if two EC_SCALARS are equal in a variable-time manner.

methods.name: ec_scalar_is_zero
methods.description: Checks if an EC_SCALAR is zero.

methods.name: ec_scalar_add
methods.description: Adds two EC_SCALARS modulo the group order.

methods.name: ec_scalar_sub
methods.description: Subtracts one EC_SCALAR from another modulo the group order.

methods.name: ec_scalar_neg
methods.description: Negates an EC_SCALAR modulo the group order.

methods.name: ec_scalar_to_montgomery
methods.description: Converts an EC_SCALAR to Montgomery form.

methods.name: ec_scalar_from_montgomery
methods.description: Converts an EC_SCALAR from Montgomery form.

methods.name: ec_scalar_mul_montgomery
methods.description: Multiplies two EC_SCALARS in Montgomery form.

methods.name: ec_scalar_inv0_montgomery
methods.description: Computes the inverse of an EC_SCALAR in Montgomery form, or zero if input is zero.

methods.name: ec_scalar_to_montgomery_inv_vartime
methods.description: Computes the inverse of an EC_SCALAR in Montgomery form in a variable-time manner.

methods.name: ec_scalar_select
methods.description: Constant-time selection between two EC_SCALARS based on a mask.

methods.name: ec_bignum_to_felem
methods.description: Converts a BIGNUM to an EC_FELEM (field element).

methods.name: ec_felem_to_bignum
methods.description: Converts an EC_FELEM to a BIGNUM.

methods.name: ec_felem_to_bytes
methods.description: Serializes an EC_FELEM to bytes.

methods.name: ec_felem_from_bytes
methods.description: Deserializes bytes into an EC_FELEM.

methods.name: ec_felem_neg
methods.description: Negates an EC_FELEM.

methods.name: ec_felem_add
methods.description: Adds two EC_FELEMs.

methods.name: ec_felem_sub
methods.description: Subtracts one EC_FELEM from another.

methods.name: ec_felem_non_zero_mask
methods.description: Returns a mask indicating if an EC_FELEM is non-zero.

methods.name: ec_felem_select
methods.description: Constant-time selection between two EC_FELEMs.

methods.name: ec_felem_equal
methods.description: Checks if two EC_FELEMs are equal.

methods.name: ec_affine_to_jacobian
methods.description: Converts an affine point to Jacobian coordinates.

methods.name: ec_jacobian_to_affine
methods.description: Converts a Jacobian point to affine coordinates.

methods.name: ec_jacobian_to_affine_batch
methods.description: Converts multiple Jacobian points to affine coordinates.

methods.name: ec_point_set_affine_coordinates
methods.description: Sets an EC_AFFINE point from x and y EC_FELEMs.

methods.name: ec_point_mul_scalar
methods.description: Multiplies a point by a scalar.

methods.name: ec_point_mul_scalar_base
methods.description: Multiplies the generator point by a scalar.

methods.name: ec_point_mul_scalar_batch
methods.description: Performs multiple scalar multiplications and additions of points.

methods.name: ec_init_precomp
methods.description: Precomputes multiples of a point for faster repeated multiplication.

methods.name: ec_point_mul_scalar_precomp
methods.description: Performs scalar multiplication using precomputed tables.

methods.name: ec_point_mul_scalar_public
methods.description: Performs scalar multiplication with public inputs, assumed constant-time.

methods.name: ec_point_mul_scalar_public_batch
methods.description: Performs batch scalar multiplication with public inputs.

methods.name: ec_point_select
methods.description: Constant-time selection between two points.

methods.name: ec_affine_select
methods.description: Constant-time selection between two affine points.

methods.name: ec_precomp_select
methods.description: Constant-time selection between two precomputed tables.

methods.name: ec_cmp_x_coordinate
methods.description: Compares the x-coordinate of a point with a scalar.

methods.name: ec_get_x_coordinate_as_scalar
methods.description: Extracts the x-coordinate of a point as a scalar.

methods.name: ec_get_x_coordinate_as_bytes
methods.description: Serializes the x-coordinate of a point to bytes.

methods.name: ec_point_byte_len
methods.description: Returns the byte length of a point in a given encoding form.

methods.name: ec_point_to_bytes
methods.description: Serializes a point to bytes in a specified form.

methods.name: ec_point_from_uncompressed
methods.description: Parses an uncompressed point from bytes.

methods.name: ec_set_to_safe_point
methods.description: Sets a point to a safe default (generator or infinity).

methods.name: ec_affine_jacobian_equal
methods.description: Checks if an affine point and a Jacobian point are the same.
